data_description.enable_dwd_source: Use DWD MOSMIX-L station data as a forecast source. Requires a valid station code.
data_description.enable_open_meteo_source: Use Open-Meteo global forecast as a forecast source. No API key required.
data_description.enable_forecast_solar_source: Use forecast.solar as a forecast source. Public API: 12 requests/hour, 1 call per PV array. Optional API key unlocks higher limits.
data_description.forecast_solar_api_key: Optional forecast.solar API key for personal/professional accounts. Leave empty for public (free) access.
data_description.source_weight_dwd: Weight for DWD source (0-100). All active source weights are normalized, so relative values matter, not absolute.
data_description.source_weight_open_meteo: Weight for Open-Meteo source (0-100). Normalized with other active sources.
data_description.source_weight_forecast_solar: Weight for forecast.solar source (0-100). Normalized with other active sources.
data_description.open_meteo_forecast_days: How many days Open-Meteo should return (up to 16 days).
data_description.daily_yield_sensor_days: How many daily yield sensors should be created as separate entities (today, tomorrow, etc.).
data_description.mosmix_station: DWD station code used for MOSMIX-L data. Example: N7244
data_description.pv_arrays: JSON list with one item per orientation. Example values: peak=2300 azimuth=95 tilt=35; peak=4600 azimuth=270 tilt=30
data_description.damping_morning: 0.0 to 1.0, where 0.1 means 10% reduction in morning hours.
data_description.damping_evening: 0.0 to 1.0, where 0.1 means 10% reduction in evening hours.
data_description.inverter_size: Optional AC limit in Watt. Example: 6000
data_description.horizon: Ignore sun below this elevation in degrees. Typical values: 0-15
data_description.enable_self_optimization: Learns correction factors from measured power and applies them by orientation, hour and season.
data_description.real_power_entities: JSON list with one measured power entity per PV array in the same order as pv_arrays.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Optional battery SOC entity. Learning is paused when SOC is above threshold.
data_description.battery_charge_power_entity: Optional battery charge power entity. Learning is paused when charge power reaches the charge limit.
data_description.battery_charge_limit: Optional battery charge limit used with battery charge power entity.
data_description.battery_soc_threshold: When battery SOC is at or above this value, learning is skipped.
